title: Playwright CLI vs MCP Server: Which is Actually BETTER for Claude Code?
summary: Compares Playwright CLI (as a skill) with the Playwright MCP server for Claude Code on token use and features.

assertions.quote: already 15% of the context is being used because all of these MCP tools are being loaded

verdicts.note: Each MCP server injects tool schemas into context; large servers can use tens of thousands of tokens, and agents use CLIs well. Deferred tool loading has since reduced this.

assertions.quote: Notice it only takes up 68 tokens

verdicts.note: Skills load only short descriptions until used, and deferred tool loading cuts context; this is how Claude Code, Manus and others manage large capability sets.
